cases.title: High load, modest CPU: follow the I/O stalls
cases.description: Does adding CPU address work waiting on storage? Illustrative 90-second trace: intervals 21–60 show the scenario; other intervals show a baseline. These are hand-designed signals, not a physics simulation.

cases.title: CPU contention: execution plus waiting
cases.description: High utilization becomes more meaningful when runnable work also waits. Illustrative 90-second trace: intervals 21–60 show the scenario; other intervals show a baseline. These are hand-designed signals, not a physics simulation.

cases.title: Memory pressure: look beyond a used-memory chart
cases.description: Low available memory and stalled work warrant investigation of reclaim and limits. Illustrative 90-second trace: intervals 21–60 show the scenario; other intervals show a baseline. These are hand-designed signals, not a physics simulation.

cases.title: Healthy cache: avoid a false memory alarm
cases.description: Large filesystem cache with available memory and negligible pressure is not evidence of exhaustion. Illustrative 90-second trace: intervals 21–60 show the scenario; other intervals show a baseline. These are hand-designed signals, not a physics simulation.
